en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 4. He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji’abi reported to me from ‘Ali ibn Ishaq al-Makhrami, who reported from Uthman ibn Abdillah al-Shami, who reported from ibn Luhayah, from Abu Zura’h al-Hadhrami, from Umar ibn ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, from his father, peace be upon him that:

The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said: "O ‘Ali! With us Allah completed His religion, the same way as He initiated it, and with us He will unite your hearts (in love) after the enmity and hatred."
